title: From the Deep
description: Reel in fish and foes, with changing odds based on biome and time.
body:
# From the Deep🎣
Make certain items that are fished up spawn as mobs, allowing players to hook mobs such as fish, frogs, and guardians. Also makes it so some mobs have increased odds for being fished in specific biomes, and make some hooked mobs spawn only at night.

## Updates
- V 1.3 Changed the description to actually be able to fit on the screen.
